answer: Verifiable pseudorandom graph topologies replace naive trust with cryptoeconomic insulation. We construct an asynchronous validator atlas where dynamic slashing matrices partition ephemeral identities like drifting sand across an adversarial dune. Colluders forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture. Inter-shard validation then maps identity density against a strict nebula quorum threshold to permanently purge sybils.
